facts.fact: The reserve is beside Puerto Madero and near the historic centre.
Habitats include forests, grasslands, lagoons and wetlands.
The tourism office lists walking paths, birdwatching and interpretive walkways.

title: Turismo Buenos Aires — Reserva Ecológica Costanera Sur
